summary: In Seattle, Washington, Seattle RainWise Residential Stormwater Retrofits is an implementation initiative. The program uses rebates and approved-contractor support for rain gardens and cisterns on eligible private properties. Heavy rainfall and stormwater entering combined sewer infrastructure can contribute to polluted overflows. The available materials describe the program and its implementation status but do not report an outcome. The source documents the action and its implementation context. It does not by itself establish broader effectiveness or outcomes beyond the reported evidence.
